subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeb176f758e1117759ad4fa0e1f8c250d3dec9095f69869f5cd172cf3fd72d27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic:** - 4 and + 1 respectively in the positional value of letters.**

Option 1) JH - FI 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2d55efb5cdd7ff602a37633235dbc9243a417c69365878316ee679e4cfaef8e.png] 

Option 2) QO - MP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56b5e61387ffbe9dadb17cf833e414430f4b9de03fcdf924d49016d14f8d1f64.png] 

**Option 3) NL - JL **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6df0c8f3befa6d7fcd31b650d3843216bdb2459108e90ba71583f518b063f231.png] 

Option 4) TR - PS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf61b846f758baf5195bc6385002355a338485c471d27d2b0c9693131991ce5e.png]
